about: The measurements a signal or a filter can take of one field, as DATA. A measure is a list of steps from the closed set below (the finder's read-data/signals.mjs does each one); adding a measure is adding a row here, and the finder runs it with no code edit. `needs` names the signal fields the measure reads besides `of`.

steps.meaning: Take the value of the field named by `of`. A field the item lacks makes the whole measure missing.
Keep the entries of a list whose words contain any word of `matching`, ignoring capitals.
Keep the entries of a list dated within `within_days` days before now.
Replace the list with how many entries it holds.
Replace the list with the part of the whole list it makes: entries kept divided by entries read.
Replace a date with how many whole days ago it was.
Read the value as a number; text that is not a number makes the measure missing.

measures.meaning: The field as a number, such as a head count.
How many days ago the dated field was, such as how long a post has been open.
How many entries of a list mention any of the words.
How many dated entries of a list fall in the last days.
The part of a list's dated entries that fall in the last days.
